tasks.task: Draft a risk assessment for a task, area or site

items.when: When you have the firm's tasks, equipment and incident history and need rated hazards and controls
Before rating anything, to list the ways the job could go wrong that nobody has named yet
When a control relies on people remembering, to make the wrong move impossible or loud
When the assessment is drafted, to have it tested for hidden assumptions and missed failures
When the risk sits in handovers, warnings and what happens when two things go wrong at once

tasks.task: Write daily and weekly inspection checklists

items.when: When each control in a risk assessment must become a line someone can tick on site
When past slips are logged, to turn them into one page of pass or fail questions
When the checklist is drafted, to cut each line to plain words a busy crew will read
When people tick every box without looking and the form itself is the problem

tasks.task: Set up an incident and near-miss form and log

items.when: When the firm needs a report form, a log and a check of each incident against reporting rules
When reports should come in on a phone form that emails an alert and logs a row
When you say an incident is or is not reportable, to tie the call to the dated official rule

tasks.task: Investigate an incident or near miss and close it out

items.when: When any injury, near miss, dangerous event or damage is reported and steps must run in order
Before the review meeting, to set who attends, the ground rules and a no-blame agenda
When the same thing keeps happening, to get a chain of whys checked against the facts
When the causes are known, to size a fix at each level with an owner, a date and a check
When the incident shows the procedure is wrong, to get a new draft and tracked actions
When the report blames a person and nobody has gone to watch how the work is really done

tasks.task: Raise a nonconformance and plan the corrective action

items.when: When a complaint, failed inspection, audit finding or defect needs a record and a fix
When the cause is unclear, to run a no-blame review with a checked chain of whys
When there is defect data, to rank the biggest causes before choosing what to correct
When an action is proposed, to check it is sized to the problem and has a way to verify it

tasks.task: Run a clause-by-clause gap review against an ISO standard

items.when: When the firm wants to know where it stands against ISO 9001, 14001 or 45001
Before the review, to map how the work really flows and who does each step
When procedures already exist, to find missing owners, stale pages and gaps
When records and controls exist, to list the gaps an auditor would find first

tasks.task: Write the policy, manual and procedures the firm needs

items.when: When the gap review is done and documents must be written in order of need
When one process needs a flowchart, who does what and a written procedure with edge cases
When a new procedure must also be gap checked, proofread and taught to staff
When an approved policy must be explained to staff in plain words
When a document reads like a standard, to cut it to what people will use

tasks.task: Build a document and record control register

items.when: When every controlled document needs an owner, a version, a review date and a home
Before the register, to decide what gets written down, where it lives and how it stays fresh
Each quarter, to find documents with no owner or past their review date

tasks.task: Plan an internal audit and write the audit checklists

items.when: Before the plan, to take the clauses and processes the audit must cover
When you need a test plan, sample sizes and a way to rate each gap found
When the audit finds something, to raise it as a finding with a corrective action

tasks.task: Get ready for a certification or surveillance audit

items.when: When the firm decides to certify or move a certificate to a new edition
When evidence is scattered, to get an index, a gap list and a plan with owners and dates
When evidence is expired or missing, to draft a request to each owner
Each quarter, to check last quarter's fixes held and what to close before the auditor comes

tasks.task: Build a first-day safety induction for new starters

items.when: When an employee, agency worker, contractor or volunteer starts on site
When the starters are volunteers and need a procedure, a practice plan and supervision
At the end of the induction, to check the starter took in the rules that matter

tasks.task: Write five-minute toolbox talks with a sign-in sheet

items.when: When a crew needs a short talk drawn from the firm's own risk assessment
When the supervisor hates reading from a sheet, to build the talk from their own site stories
After each talk, to get three quick questions that show whether it landed
When a talk repeats rules and never shows, with a plain example, why they exist

tasks.task: Plan a 52-week toolbox talk and training calendar

items.when: Before the calendar, to list the talks the risk assessments call for
When key topics must come back through the year at sensible gaps
When the talks must fit with inspections, drills and reviews in one yearly calendar

tasks.task: Run a business impact review and outline a continuity plan

items.when: When a customer, insurer or landlord asks for a continuity plan
Before the review, to map the clients, suppliers and systems the firm cannot do without
When a supplier failure is a top risk, to set a backup and who does what if it breaks
When one person holds key knowledge, to plan who could step in and what they need
When the plan is drafted, to find where the firm still breaks under stress
When a calm record is taken as proof that nothing serious can happen

tasks.task: Set the IT and data recovery order

items.when: When you need how much data loss the firm can take and a backup plan to match
When backups have never been tested, to plan a safe restore test with an evidence log
After a restore test, to compare the evidence with the recovery targets
Before ordering systems, to take the recovery times the business said it needs

tasks.task: Build an emergency contact tree and message pack

items.when: When phones or email may be down, to set fallback routes, owners and a safe test
When customers must be told, to draft the first notice, the updates and the all-clear
When staff must be told, to get a first-hour message and a 24-hour action list
Before any message, to compare ways of covering essential work with the staff you have
When the pack is drafted, to read it as a customer and list what they would still ask

tasks.task: Run a one-hour continuity practice exercise

items.when: When a plan has never been tested or has changed and needs a timed tabletop exercise
When choosing the scenario, to see how several things going wrong at once hit each team
After the exercise, to write one page on what to repeat and what to change

tasks.task: Estimate a carbon footprint from the firm's own records

items.when: When you have energy, fuel and travel records and a named emission factor set
When shipping and supplier data must be added, to work out emissions by source
When the sums are done, to check units and carry the error margin through to the total
When the footprint lives in a spreadsheet, to find formula errors and broken links
When one headline number hides what was counted, what was left out and how rough it is

tasks.task: Write a short, honest sustainability report

items.when: Before writing, to pick the topics that matter, the framework and the data gaps
When you have the environmental, social and governance data and need a draft report
When the firm sells into the EU, to see whether reporting rules apply and what to disclose
When the report needs a 12-month plan, to compare two ways of spending the budget
Before it is published, to check every green claim in the report against the records
When the report is drafted, to read it as the customer who asked for it

tasks.task: Plan 12 months of cuts to emissions and waste

items.when: Before the plan, to take the baseline and the biggest sources
When you want process waste mapped and quick fixes ranked by payoff
When the firm sells goods, to rank what to reuse, repair, refurbish or recycle
When the budget is fixed, to compare two plans that place different bets
When an upgrade costs money, to work out payback before it goes in the plan

tasks.task: Check green claims before they are published

items.when: When the firm wants to say it is greener and you need each claim tied to its records
When claims sit in ad or page copy, to sort each as fine, needs proof or cut
When you have the evidence file, to see which claims it supports and which go too far

tasks.task: Answer a customer QHSE, ESG or tender questionnaire

items.when: When a customer, tender or supplier portal sends a questionnaire and wants honest answers
When the questionnaire is long, to sort questions by must have and see where you fit
When it has an IT security section, to answer with sources and an evidence index
Before it is submitted, to tie every answer to a dated record or soften it

tasks.task: Review supplier quality and corrective action replies

items.when: When a supplier replies to a defect, to check the reply against your inspection evidence
When the supplier sends proof of the fix, to test it against your acceptance standard
When you need a risk score for each supplier and warning signs to watch
When suppliers must be asked about ethics and environment, to get the questionnaire to send

tasks.task: Run the monthly QHSE review and report to management

items.when: Each month, for the one-hour review and the fixed points in the yearly calendar
When management asks for numbers, to pick the few measures they will act on
After the review, to hold every action with an owner, a date and its source
Before the review, to pull the month's incidents, near misses and open actions

always.when: When a document cites a law, a standard clause or a figure, to tie it to a dated source or cut it
Before any document is issued, to catch typos and terms used two ways
When a document is written for the auditor and not for the people who must use it

helpers.when: When the question is what the law requires in a given country, not how to document it
When the continuity plan needs real backup, restore and access steps for the firm's systems
When a manual or a large procedure set must be written to one standard
When induction or safety training must become a course with practice and assessment
When supplier approval, audits and contract terms must change after a quality failure
When the questionnaire is part of a full tender with method statements and pricing

gaps: No library item runs a gap review against ISO 9001, 14001 or 45001; the ISO items cover security and medical devices only
No library item drafts a workplace health and safety risk assessment with a rating scale and the hierarchy of controls
No library item writes site inspection checklists for workshops, warehouses, kitchens or building sites
No library item checks an injury or incident against RIDDOR, OSHA or EU national reporting rules
No library item writes toolbox talks, a 52-week talk calendar or a sign-in sheet for crews
No library item covers hazardous substances, manual handling, fire and evacuation plans or permits to work
No library item plans an internal audit programme for a management system or writes audit reports
No library item runs a business impact review or writes a continuity plan for a small firm with one site
No library item scripts a tabletop exercise with timed updates, or offers different scenarios to compare
No library item estimates scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions with named emission factors and their year
No library item answers ESG rating questionnaires such as EcoVadis or CDP
No library item builds a legal register, a training and competence matrix or a calibration register
No thinking lens covers quality management or safety science, such as variation, checklists or just culture
